title: Radioactive iodine treatment
what: You swallow a capsule or drink a liquid with radioactive iodine. It collects in the thyroid gland and gradually shrinks or destroys its tissue.
why: For an overactive thyroid and after surgery for thyroid cancer.
duration: taking the capsule takes a few minutes; you usually stay in the ward for a few days, depending on clinic rules
tell_doctor: Pregnancy, or if you could be pregnant. The treatment is not given during pregnancy
Breastfeeding. It must be stopped in advance, and the doctor will say when
Recent CT scans with contrast, as contrast contains iodine
If you have small children or pregnant women at home

prepare.title: Diet
prepare.text: Usually for 1 to 2 weeks before treatment you follow a low-iodine diet: no seafood, seaweed or iodized salt. The clinic will give the exact list.

prepare.title: Hormones
prepare.text: Do not stop on your own. If thyroid hormones must be paused, the doctor will say when and how.

prepare.title: Test
prepare.text: Women usually have a pregnancy test before treatment.

prepare.title: Belongings
prepare.text: Bring as little as possible. Some of it is best washed separately afterward.

bring: A change of clothes and simple things for a few days
steps: You are placed in a separate room
The doctor explains the rules once more
You swallow the capsule or drink the liquid with water
For the first hours you usually cannot eat
You drink a lot and go to the toilet often, so the extra iodine leaves faster
A specialist measures the radiation, and when it drops enough you are discharged
feel: You do not feel the dose itself
Sometimes a dry mouth, a change in taste, mild nausea
Swelling and tenderness in the neck can occur in the first days
Isolation is boring, so bring a book or headphones
after: For several days after discharge keep your distance from people, especially children and pregnant women. The doctor will give the time
Sleep alone and use your own dishes and towel
Flush the toilet often and wash your hands well
Pregnancy is usually postponed for the time the doctor advises
Follow-up hormone tests in a few weeks
red_flags: Severe swelling of the neck, trouble breathing or swallowing: call your local emergency number
Heavy vomiting so you cannot drink

faq.q: Will I be dangerous to my family?
faq.a: For a short time after treatment, yes, which is why distance rules are needed. The doctor will tell you how many days to follow them.

faq.q: Can I drink a lot of water?
faq.a: Yes, you even should. Water helps the extra iodine leave the body faster.

reminders.text: Radioactive iodine treatment in 2 days. Keep following the low-iodine diet and pack simple things for a few days.
